description: This file contains an implementation of the MD5 hashing algorithm, including functions for initialization, processing data, and finalizing the hash, with platform-specific byte order handling.

methods.name: md5_process
methods.description: Processes a 64-byte block of data to update the MD5 state.

methods.name: md5_append
methods.description: Appends data to the MD5 context for hashing.

methods.name: md5_finish
methods.description: Finalizes the MD5 hash and outputs the digest.
